g.title: pine
g.text: a dashed border is an operating-system process of its own, and every
arrow across one is an asynchronous tell both ways, so neither side
can hang the other and only data crosses

g.title: cluster_daemon
g.text: the daemon - one headless image, no display

g.title: tree
g.text: one nested persistent map, one atomic reference
text point mark mode file prop readtable view selection
the arrangement; a split is a write
everything that runs, at any blast radius
a fault, its restarts still live
a language: its grammar and what it paints
the one place a command line runs
resolved on read; a selector names its own path
a slot read and a walk; no lock, safe in any receive
a compare-and-swap onto a new root

g.title: tree->node2
g.text: each commit ships the paths that moved
